name: Intuitive Surgical valuation watch
thesis: Intuitive Surgical remains a high-quality business, but assessed base-case upside of 2.5% is below the 10% entry minimum and its upside-to-downside ratio is below 1:1, so cash is currently preferable.
entry_rule: Do not open or increase while base-case upside is below 10% or the base-upside-to-downside ratio is below 1:1; require a current allocation plan and assessment before reactivation.
exit_rule: No live exposure exists; keep the strategy paused until a fresh assessment clears every configured payoff and risk gate.
invalidation: Reassess if price, fundamentals, procedure growth, recurring revenue, competitive position, or the valuation range changes enough to clear the configured payoff gates.
